conventions.convention: The selection event is one fixed finite polyhedron S={y:Ay≤b}, with coordinatewise inequalities, n≥1, m≥0, and fixed nonzero contrast η. T=ηᵀy, Z=(I−Pη)y, and cη=η/‖η‖².

Negative row coefficients give lower bounds, positive coefficients give upper bounds, and zero coefficients require d_j(z)≥0. Empty lower and upper index sets give −∞ and +∞ respectively; infeasible fibers are empty.
Assume AC and Y∼N_n(μ,σ²I_n) with known σ>0. The contrast scale is s=σ‖η‖; Φ(−∞)=0 and Φ(+∞)=1. The pivot is extended by zero outside selection and on zero-normalizer fibers.
Conditional fiber laws are asserted only almost everywhere under the selected residual marginal, with positive selection probability. Zero-normalizer fibers have zero selected marginal probability.

Exact selective coverage is equality for each parameter under its conditional sampling law and requires measurable true-functional membership sections; no measurable structure on the parameter or estimand set is imposed.

The conditional experiment uses S with its trace Borel sigma-algebra and parameter set Θ_S={μ:P_μ(S)>0}. P-value validity requires a nonempty null; test size additionally uses a specified nonempty disjoint alternative. Confidence-set candidates belong to Θ_η.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC and the setup of def-polyhedral-selective-normal-pivot, with P_μ(S)>0. For P_μ(Z∈·|S)-almost every z, the conditional law of T given Z=z and S is N(θ,s²) restricted to [L(z),U(z)] and normalized by Δ_θ(z)>0. Its CDF is q_θ(t,z); the pivot is Borel measurable and uniform conditionally on the residual and selection, and on selection alone.
For every y∈Rⁿ, Ay≤b if and only if G(Z(y)) and L(Z(y))≤T(y)≤U(Z(y)). The functions L,U are extended-real Borel measurable, and the set of pairs satisfying the right-hand side is Borel.
Assume AC. Let Y∼N_n(μ,σ²I_n) with known σ>0 and fixed η≠0. Then T=ηᵀY and Z=(I_n−Pη)Y are independent, and T∼N(ηᵀμ,σ²‖η‖²).
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let Φ(x)=P(Z≤x) for Z∼N(0,1). Then Φ is continuous and strictly increasing on R, with limits zero at −∞ and one at +∞.

In the stated conditional Gaussian experiment, for a nonempty contrast null, p_ϑ=2min{q_ϑ,1−q_ϑ} is uniform under every null law and its threshold test has exact conditional type-I error α. With a specified nonempty disjoint alternative its size is α. The central pivot inversion over Θ_η has exact selective coverage 1−α for the fixed contrast.
